title: NCEA
lead: New Zealand's national school qualification: how it works today, whether it meets University Entrance, and what the reform changes for your child.
reformBanner: NCEA is being reformed. The replacement qualifications are still being finalised, so anything marked below can still change - check education.govt.nz for the latest.

nav.whichOne: Which qualification will my child sit?

howItWorks.title: How NCEA works
howItWorks.lead: Three levels, a credit system, and a literacy/numeracy gate that applies to all of them.

notAchieved.label: Not Achieved (N)
notAchieved.body: The standard was not met, so it earns no credits.

achieved.label: Achieved (A)
achieved.body: The standard was met. Credits are earned.

merit.label: Merit (M)
merit.body: Met with in-depth understanding. Counts towards endorsements.

excellence.label: Excellence (E)
excellence.body: Met with comprehensive understanding. Counts towards endorsements.

certificateEndorsement.title: Certificate endorsement
certificateEndorsement.body: 50 credits at Merit (or Merit and Excellence) endorses the certificate with Merit; 50 credits at Excellence endorses it with Excellence. The credits must be at the level of the certificate or above.

courseEndorsement.title: Course endorsement
courseEndorsement.body: In a single school year: 14 or more credits at Achieved, Merit or Excellence, including at least 3 from externally assessed standards and 3 from internally assessed standards. Some subjects without external standards are exempt.

university.title: University Entrance check
university.lead: UE has four parts and you need all four. Enter your child's expected credits and each one lights up.
university.level3Checkbox: NCEA Level 3 has been (or is expected to be) awarded
university.subjectsHint: You need {{count}} approved subjects with {{credits}} Level 3 credits each. Only NZQA-approved subjects count.
university.beyondUe: UE is the minimum. Individual universities and programmes set their own rank scores and required subjects - check their own pages.

calculator.title: Credits & endorsement estimator
calculator.lead: Estimate whether a level is met and which endorsement it would reach. An estimate, not an official result.
calculator.estimateOnly: This is an estimate based on what you enter. Your official result comes from NZQA.
calculator.creditsRow: At least {{required}} credits at this level or above
calculator.endorsementHint: Course endorsement needs 14 credits plus at least 3 internal and 3 external. If you leave the internal/external split blank we do not award it, so this estimate is conservative.
calculator.noSubjects: No subjects added for this level yet.

changes.title: What is changing
changes.lead: NCEA is being replaced in stages by new qualifications. Dates and design are not final.
changes.subjectRuleValue: At least {{min}} subjects, pass at least {{pass}}
changes.notPublished: Not published by the Ministry yet.

whichOne.title: Which qualification will my child sit?
whichOne.lead: Enter the current year level and we will work through the published timeline year by year.
whichOne.pickYearLevel: Pick a year level to see the year-by-year path.

disclaimer: This tool is for family planning only and is not admissions advice. Current NCEA and UE requirements follow NZQA and each university's own website. NCEA is under reform and the replacement qualifications (Foundational Award / NZCE / NZACE) are still being finalised - follow education.govt.nz for the latest. Talk to your school's careers or academic adviser.
